import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { Link, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom"; // useNavigate instead of useHistory import { getAuth, signOut } from "firebase/auth"; // Updated Firebase imports import { getFirestore, doc, getDoc } from "firebase/firestore"; // Import Firestore functions import { Navbar, Nav, UncontrolledDropdown, DropdownToggle, DropdownMenu, DropdownItem, Media, Container } from "reactstrap"; // Import necessary components const AdminNavbar = (props) => { const navigate = useNavigate(); // useNavigate hook for navigation const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState("Loading..."); // State to store the first name // Fetch user data from Firestore on component mount useEffect(() => { const auth = getAuth(); const user = auth.currentUser; if (user) { const db = getFirestore(); // Construct the path to the user info document const userRef = doc(db, "users", `${user.uid}-userinfo`); // Fetch the user data from Firestore getDoc(userRef) .then((docSnap) => { if (docSnap.exists()) { const userData = docSnap.data(); setFirstName(userData.firstName || "User"); // Update first name state } else { setFirstName("User"); // Fallback to "User" if document does not exist } }) .catch((error) => { console.error("Error fetching user data: ", error); setFirstName("User"); // Fallback to "User" if there's an error }); } }, []); // Handle logout functionality const handleLogout = async () => { try { const auth = getAuth(); await signOut(auth); // Sign out from Firebase console.log("User logged out successfully"); // Redirect to login page after logout navigate("/login"); } catch (error) { console.error("Error logging out: ", error); } }; return ( <>
